comparison.objective: Remove a retaining bar and open the top drawer.
comparison.physical_skill: Recognize a mechanical obstruction, slide a loose bar from two sleeves, then pull the drawer.
comparison.success_condition: Drawer opened at least 18 cm; bar removal earns partial credit, while damage or cabinet motion fails.
comparison.reason: Sequential restraint removal is not equivalent to fracturing a manufactured tang while retaining the surrounding insert and collecting the released piece.
